## v0.5.56 · Consistent Web UI tooltips and clearer Runtime errors / 统一界面提示与更清晰的运行时记忆报错

### English

- Mnemon's Web UI uses DSH tooltips for actions and truncated text. Action hints appear on hover and keyboard focus. ([#745](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/745))
- When a Runtime memory call omits a field required for its action, the error names the action and missing field and includes a one-line JSON example. ([#747](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/747))

### 简体中文

- Mnemon Web UI 的操作和截断文本提示使用 DSH 气泡。操作按钮支持鼠标悬停和键盘聚焦。([#745](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/745))
- 运行时记忆调用漏填必填字段时，报错会指出操作、缺失字段，并给出一行 JSON 调用示例。([#747](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/747))

Update from **Memory System → Status → Versions → Update**, then fully restart DSH. / 在**记忆系统 → 状态 → 版本 → 更新**中升级，然后完整重启 DSH。
